messages.content: Solve the mathematics question using the provided image. Give a clear final answer at the end. For a multiple-choice question, include the option letter in your final answer.

content.text: Three circular hoops are joined together so that they intersect at rightangles as shown. A path starts at an intersection and follows the outside of the hoops by repeating this procedure: travel along a quarter-circle, turn $90^{\circ}$ to the right, travel along a quarter-circle and turn $90^{\circ}$ to the left. How many quarter-circles does the path traverse before first returning to its starting point?
